en: Black-and-white postcard showing a large, rectangular multi-story brick institutional building standing alone in an open, sparsely landscaped area. The structure has many uniformly spaced windows and a glazed top floor or sunroom. A curved path or road leads toward the building across grass and bare ground. In the lower left corner, white caption text identifies the location as Vänersborg and names the facility Korseberga Kuranstalt.
